# Vintex Back-end — GitHub Copilot instructions

Read and follow `AGENTS.md` and every document it marks as required under `.ai/` before proposing or changing code.

Treat `.ai/` as the single source of truth for project context, architecture, coding rules and learning rules. Use `.ai/glossary.md` and `.ai/examples.md` when relevant.

Do not duplicate or replace those rules here. If a referenced file is unavailable to the current Copilot feature, state that limitation instead of inventing project conventions.
